    meta: {}
    title: Create Agent Payload
    type: python
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - HTTP_Request_To_Invoke_Agent: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    inputs:
      code: >-
        # Restrictions

        # - No custom package imports


        # Available Global Variables

        # - action_inputs = a restricted global variable used to access the inputs object that will be passed into the script.

        # - action_outputs = a restricted global variable used to set the output of the script.

        # - action_error = a restricted global variable that, when populated, will fail the action with the corresponding error payload.


        # Attachments

        # See https://docs.swimlane.com/using-the-script-native-action for using attachments in Script native actions.


        import uuid

        import json


        application_id = action_inputs["application_id"]

        record = action_inputs["case_record"]

        correlation_records = action_inputs.get("correlation_records", [])

        kb_records = action_inputs.get("kb_records", [])

        ti_records = action_inputs.get("ti_records", [])

        assets = action_inputs.get("assets", [])

        assets = [a for a in assets if isinstance(a, str) and not a.startswith("AI_SOC")]


        investigation_prompt = f"""

        Investigate the case using the components available in the platform. Search for the relevant components and execute them to find the relevant data of the case before providing the verdict.

        If the Observable enrichment is successfully completed, do not enrich them again by searching and executing the components again.

        Use TI_References in case.json to find enriched observables, If the enrichment is failed or missing for an observable, search & execute the components based on assets.

        Assets are the credentials configured in the environment, these can be use to find the relevant components available in the enviroment.

        List of assets configured in the tenant are: {assets}


        Note: Do not use other components/tools that are not configured in the tenant. Vendor name of the component like CrowdStrike/SentinelOne/VirusTotal must be present in the asset list to execute components.

        """



        def create_context_json():
            return {
                "applicationId": application_id,
                "trackingId": record["tracking-id"],
                "currentValues": {
                    "ai-verdict-analysis": record.get("ai-verdict-analysis"),
                    "ai-threat-analysis": record.get("ai-threat-analysis"),
                    "ai-verdict": record.get("ai-verdict"),
                    "ai-verdict-confidence": record.get("ai-verdict-confidence"),
                },
                "fieldMappings": {
                    "componentOutputsFieldKey": "component-runs",
                    "sessionFieldKey": "analysis-agent-session",
                    "aiVerdictAnalysisFieldKey": "ai-verdict-analysis",
                    "aiThreatAnalysisFieldKey": "ai-threat-analysis",
                    "aiVerdictFieldKey": "ai-verdict",
                    "aiVerdictConfidenceFieldKey": "ai-verdict-confidence",
                    "previousAiVerdictAnalysisFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict-analysis",
                    "previousAiThreatAnalysisFieldKey": "previous-ai-threat-analysis",
                    "previousAiVerdictFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict",
                    "previousAiVerdictConfidenceFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict-confidence",
                    "requestIdFieldKey": "analysis-agent-request-id",
                    "aiSocStatusFieldKey": "analysis-status",
                },
            }


        def filter_case_record():
            record_copy = record.copy()
            filter_keys = [
                "ai-verdict-analysis",
                "ai-threat-analysis",
                "ai-verdict",
                "ai-verdict-confidence",
            ]
            for key in filter_keys:
                record_copy.pop(key, None)
            return record_copy


        def parse_ti_records(ti_records):
            records = []
            for record in ti_records:
                rec = record.copy()
                enrichments = rec.get("enrichments", [])
                if isinstance(enrichments, str):
                    try:
                        enrichments = json.loads(enrichments)
                    except:
                        enrichments = []
                rec["enrichments"] = enrichments
                records.append(rec)
            return records

        def create_case_json():
            return {
                "case_details": filter_case_record(),
                "correlated_cases": correlation_records,
                "knowledge_base_references": kb_records,
                "ti_references": parse_ti_records(ti_records),
            }


        def create_payload(request_id, context_json, case_json):
            return {

inputs.code:
# Restrictions
# - No custom package imports

# Available Global Variables
# - action_inputs = a restricted global variable used to access the inputs object that will be passed into the script.
# - action_outputs = a restricted global variable used to set the output of the script.
# - action_error = a restricted global variable that, when populated, will fail the action with the corresponding error payload.

# Attachments
# See https://docs.swimlane.com/using-the-script-native-action for using attachments in Script native actions.

import uuid
import json

application_id = action_inputs["application_id"]
record = action_inputs["case_record"]
correlation_records = action_inputs.get("correlation_records", [])
kb_records = action_inputs.get("kb_records", [])
ti_records = action_inputs.get("ti_records", [])
assets = action_inputs.get("assets", [])
assets = [a for a in assets if isinstance(a, str) and not a.startswith("AI_SOC")]

investigation_prompt = f"""
Investigate the case using the components available in the platform. Search for the relevant components and execute them to find the relevant data of the case before providing the verdict.
If the Observable enrichment is successfully completed, do not enrich them again by searching and executing the components again.
Use TI_References in case.json to find enriched observables, If the enrichment is failed or missing for an observable, search & execute the components based on assets.
Assets are the credentials configured in the environment, these can be use to find the relevant components available in the enviroment.
List of assets configured in the tenant are: {assets}

Note: Do not use other components/tools that are not configured in the tenant. Vendor name of the component like CrowdStrike/SentinelOne/VirusTotal must be present in the asset list to execute components.
"""


def create_context_json():
    return {
        "applicationId": application_id,
        "trackingId": record["tracking-id"],
        "currentValues": {
            "ai-verdict-analysis": record.get("ai-verdict-analysis"),
            "ai-threat-analysis": record.get("ai-threat-analysis"),
            "ai-verdict": record.get("ai-verdict"),
            "ai-verdict-confidence": record.get("ai-verdict-confidence"),
        },
        "fieldMappings": {
            "componentOutputsFieldKey": "component-runs",
            "sessionFieldKey": "analysis-agent-session",
            "aiVerdictAnalysisFieldKey": "ai-verdict-analysis",
            "aiThreatAnalysisFieldKey": "ai-threat-analysis",
            "aiVerdictFieldKey": "ai-verdict",
            "aiVerdictConfidenceFieldKey": "ai-verdict-confidence",
            "previousAiVerdictAnalysisFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict-analysis",
            "previousAiThreatAnalysisFieldKey": "previous-ai-threat-analysis",
            "previousAiVerdictFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict",
            "previousAiVerdictConfidenceFieldKey": "previous-ai-verdict-confidence",
            "requestIdFieldKey": "analysis-agent-request-id",
            "aiSocStatusFieldKey": "analysis-status",
        },
    }


def filter_case_record():
    record_copy = record.copy()
    filter_keys = [
        "ai-verdict-analysis",
        "ai-threat-analysis",
        "ai-verdict",
        "ai-verdict-confidence",
    ]
    for key in filter_keys:
        record_copy.pop(key, None)
    return record_copy


def parse_ti_records(ti_records):
    records = []
    for record in ti_records:
        rec = record.copy()
        enrichments = rec.get("enrichments", [])
        if isinstance(enrichments, str):
            try:
                enrichments = json.loads(enrichments)
            except:
                enrichments = []
        rec["enrichments"] = enrichments
        records.append(rec)
    return records

def create_case_json():
    return {
        "case_details": filter_case_record(),
        "correlated_cases": correlation_records,
        "knowledge_base_references": kb_records,
        "ti_references": parse_ti_records(ti_records),
    }


def create_payload(request_id, context_json, case_json):
    return {
        "scope": "record",
        "requestId": request_id,
        "prompt": investigation_prompt,
        "files": [
            {
                "path": "",
                "filename": "context.json",
                "content": json.dumps(context_json, indent=1),
            },
            {
                "path": "",
                "filename": "case.json",
                "content": json.dumps(case_json, indent=1),
            },
        ],
    }


def main():
    case_json = create_case_json()
    context_json = create_context_json()

    request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    payload = create_payload(request_id, context_json, case_json)

    action_outputs["request_id"] = request_id
    action_outputs["payload"] = payload


main()
